# Study II: Prediction stability {#sec-suppl-pred-stability}
Prediction stability plots (@fig-pred_stability) revealed more stability the fewer predictors. 

::: {#fig-pred-stability}
[![](figures/4_results_fig/study_2_prediction_stability.png)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HeleneThomsen/dissertation/main/figures/4_results_fig/study_2_prediction_stability.png)

Prediction stability plots show the predictions (estimated risk) for the full dataset from the development model (equivalent to the apparent model) on the x-axis,  and the predictions from all bootstrap models on the y-axis. Tight alignment along the diagonal indicates higher prediction stability.<!--  {style="font-size: 85%; opacity: 0.85;"} -->

:::
